data.name: Settings_AboutDescription
data.value:
FloppyGames turns a physical 3.5" floppy disk, a USB stick or an NFC card into a launch key for your Steam, Epic Games and GOG Galaxy games. Insert the media: the game starts. Remove it: the game closes.
• Launch screen with the game's cover, playtime, size and achievements (the latter with the optional Steam Web API key). • Several media at once, each with its own game. • Label Studio: pick an installed game, with process, description and cover filled in automatically, write it to a floppy, USB stick or NFC card with a progress bar, and print or export the label. • Mifare Classic 1K/4K NFC cards, with a Proxmark3 or PC/SC reader: read, write, format and reprogram, with optional password protection — the card's UID is never changed. • Tray icon, start with Windows, floppy motor sound, CRT effect and 5 languages. • Everything stays local — the Internet is only used for covers and, if you want, achievements.
